_fixtures.source: league schedules via the sports data tool (not available this run; kept earlier future games)

_status.summary: Removed five past events, confirmed SantaCon (Dec 12), added Dumboween, Queens Night Market finale, Essex Market Halloween, NYBG Día de los Muertos parade and Baldwin Lee at Howard Greenberg; foliage report and sports tool unavailable, so foliage was not written and existing future games were kept.

aperture-loves-new-york.map: Aperture, 380 Columbus Ave, New York, NY
aperture-loves-new-york.name: Aperture Loves New York
aperture-loves-new-york.spot: The bookshop is in the same space. Central Park is two blocks east for shooting afterwards.
aperture-loves-new-york.time: Wed to Sat 11 am to 6 pm, Sun noon to 5 pm. Closed Mon and Tue
aperture-loves-new-york.where: Aperture, 380 Columbus Av at 78 St, Upper West Side
aperture-loves-new-york.why: A gallery installation at Aperture's space and bookshop on the Upper West Side.

baldwin-lee-new-york.map: Howard Greenberg Gallery, 41 E 57th St, New York, NY
baldwin-lee-new-york.name: Baldwin Lee: New York
baldwin-lee-new-york.spot: The show closes on Saturday October 31; the gallery is on an upper floor of the building, so check hours before going.
baldwin-lee-new-york.where: Howard Greenberg Gallery, 41 E 57 St, Midtown
baldwin-lee-new-york.why: Large-format 4x5 photographs of New York's empty early-morning streets by Baldwin Lee.

ideas.text: Show the altar small under the repeating concrete arches with people moving between them.
ideas.title: Altar under the arches

ideas.text: Isolate a face being painted, with the artist's hand and brush in the frame.
ideas.title: Face painting

ideas.text: Close in on marigolds and candles beside an industrial fitting of the terminal.
ideas.title: Marigolds and steel

bat-dia-de-los-muertos.map: Brooklyn Army Terminal, 140 58th St, Brooklyn, NY
bat-dia-de-los-muertos.name: Día de los Muertos at Brooklyn Army Terminal
bat-dia-de-los-muertos.spot: Arrive around 2 pm while people are still adding to the altar, and stay until dusk when the candles carry the light under the arches.
bat-dia-de-los-muertos.where: Brooklyn Army Terminal Arches, 140 58 St, Sunset Park
bat-dia-de-los-muertos.why: A shared altar, face painting, crafts and live music under the concrete arches of an old military terminal.

ideas.text: From the rink edge, pan with one skater at a slow shutter so the crowd and lights streak behind.
ideas.title: Skaters in a blur

ideas.text: From the upper terrace, show the full rink with the skyline closing in on all sides.
ideas.title: Rink among the towers

ideas.text: Shoot through the glass of a market stall at a vendor or shopper lit by the warm lamps inside.
ideas.title: Faces in the stall windows

bryant-park-winter-village.map: Bryant Park Upper Terrace, behind the New York Public Library, New York, NY
bryant-park-winter-village.name: Bryant Park Winter Village opening
bryant-park-winter-village.spot: The raised terrace on the library side looks down on the whole rink. Come on a weekday just after dark, when the stalls glow and the crowd is thinner.
bryant-park-winter-village.where: Bryant Park, 40 St to 42 St between Fifth and Sixth Av
bryant-park-winter-village.why: The rink and glass market stalls put skaters, shoppers and office workers in one small lit space surrounded by towers.

ideas.text: Shoot up Washington Street so the marchers fill the bottom of the frame and the bridge and Empire State Building close the top.
ideas.title: Costumes under the bridge

ideas.text: Pre-focus by the kerb and wait for a small child looking up as a large puppet passes.
ideas.title: Puppet meets child

ideas.text: After the parade, frame a costumed figure under the Archway lights as the sky turns blue.
ideas.title: Archway at dusk

dumboween.map: Washington St & Water St, Brooklyn, NY
dumboween.name: Dumboween March to the Arch
dumboween.spot: Stand at Washington St and Water St before 4 pm so the parade comes towards you with the Manhattan Bridge framed between the warehouses.
dumboween.time: 3:30 pm to 6 pm; parade at 4 pm
dumboween.where: Washington St to the Manhattan Bridge Archway, Dumbo
dumboween.why: Children and families in costume march up cobbled Washington Street to the Archway, with bands and puppets under the Manhattan Bridge.

ideas.text: Wait at the face-painting table for the moment a child sees the result in the mirror.
ideas.title: Face being painted

ideas.text: Frame a costume in front of a market stall sign that comments on it by accident.
ideas.title: Costume and market sign

ideas.text: Shoot down the closed block so costumes, the market front and the old tenements stack up.
ideas.title: Broome Street block

essex-market-halloween.map: Essex Market, 88 Essex St, New York, NY
essex-market-halloween.name: Essex Market Halloween
essex-market-halloween.spot: Stand by the face-painting table early on, then move to the costume contest; the market windows behind give a busy Lower East Side backdrop.
essex-market-halloween.where: Broome St outside 88 Essex St, Lower East Side
essex-market-halloween.why: A block of Broome Street fills with costumed children, face painting and a costume contest outside the market.

halloween.where: Sixth Av, Canal St north to 15 St

ideas.text: Frame a lit float passing under the Apollo marquee with the crowd along the kerb.
ideas.title: Floats at the Apollo

ideas.text: Watch the crowd's faces as a float lights them up when it passes.
ideas.title: Lit faces

ideas.text: Use a slow shutter so the float lights streak while the people watching stay still.
ideas.title: Light trails

harlem-holiday-lights.map: W 125th St & Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd, New York, NY
harlem-holiday-lights.name: Harlem Holiday Lights
harlem-holiday-lights.spot: Stand at 125 St and Adam Clayton Powell Jr Blvd near the Apollo. The start time is not yet published, so check closer to the date.
harlem-holiday-lights.why: Illuminated floats, music and performances move along 125 St after dark, with the Apollo marquee and shop lights as a backdrop.

ideas.text: Catch a small child in full costume looking up at a parent, or being carried when the walk gets long.
ideas.title: Costume and parent

ideas.text: Look for a costumed adult doing something ordinary, such as buying a coffee or checking a phone.
ideas.title: Monster at the bodega

ideas.text: Shoot down the avenue so the line of costumes runs between the shop signs and awnings.
ideas.title: Parade on 37 Av

jackson-heights-halloween-parade.map: 37th Ave & 89th St, Jackson Heights, Queens, NY
jackson-heights-halloween-parade.name: Jackson Heights Halloween Parade
jackson-heights-halloween-parade.spot: Stand on 37 Av near the start at 89 St to see the groups line up. Listings give different start times, so check locally before going.
jackson-heights-halloween-parade.where: 37 Av, 89 St to 76 St, Jackson Heights, Queens
jackson-heights-halloween-parade.why: A daytime neighbourhood parade of children and families in costume, with good light and far more room than the Village parade.

ideas.text: Fill the frame with marigolds, candles, sugar skulls and the framed photos people have left.
ideas.title: Offerings on the altar

ideas.text: Wait at the altar for someone setting down an offering and pausing for a second after.
ideas.title: Placing a photo

ideas.text: Isolate one person in skull face paint against the dark stone of the church.
ideas.title: Painted face

mano-a-mano-day-of-the-dead.map: St. Mark's Church in-the-Bowery, 131 E 10th St, New York, NY
mano-a-mano-day-of-the-dead.name: Mano a Mano Day of the Dead
mano-a-mano-day-of-the-dead.spot: Go early on the first day while the altar is still being built and people are placing offerings. Work close to the altar and ask before photographing anyone leaving a photo of a relative.
mano-a-mano-day-of-the-dead.where: St. Mark's Church-in-the-Bowery, 131 E 10 St, East Village
mano-a-mano-day-of-the-dead.why: A large community altar with marigolds, candles and sugar skulls draws people who come to leave offerings, with live music and a Mexican market around it.

marathon.note: In the Bronx the course now continues up Alexander Av, then E 141 St and Third Av, before E 138 St and the Madison Av Bridge.

ideas.text: Fill the frame with the marigolds, candles and family photos on the ofrenda.
ideas.title: Marigolds and photos

ideas.text: Isolate one painted face against the out-of-focus autumn colour.
ideas.title: Painted face in the leaves

ideas.text: Pre-focus where the procession leaves the ofrenda and catch the first steps.
ideas.title: Procession sets off

nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.map: New York Botanical Garden, 2900 Southern Blvd, Bronx, NY
nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.name: Día de los Muertos parade at NYBG
nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.spot: Find the ofrenda well before 2 pm so you are at the head of the procession as it forms; the garden ticket is needed to enter.
nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.time: Parade at 2 pm; included in the All-Garden Pass, ticket needed
nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.where: New York Botanical Garden, starting near the ofrenda, Bronx
nybg-dia-de-los-muertos.why: A procession starts at the garden's ofrenda, with marigolds, painted faces and families among the autumn trees.

ideas.text: Catch a child in costume reacting to a large puppet passing a few feet away.
ideas.title: Face to face with a puppet

ideas.text: Shoot a costumed figure against a lit shop window as the light goes.
ideas.title: Costume in the window light

ideas.text: Pan with a band at a slow shutter so the instruments blur against the brownstones.
ideas.title: Band in motion

park-slope-halloween-parade.name: Park Slope Halloween Parade
park-slope-halloween-parade.spot: Stand at 7th Av and 9th St by the subway exit, where the parade passes shopfronts lit from inside. Arrive by 6 pm to find a spot at the kerb.
park-slope-halloween-parade.time: 6:30 pm; people line up from about 6 pm
park-slope-halloween-parade.where: Seventh Av, 14 St to 3 St, Park Slope
park-slope-halloween-parade.why: Costumed families, musicians, puppets and local groups fill Seventh Av at dusk in a neighbourhood parade running since 1986.

ideas.text: Frame a cook through the smoke with only the stall lights on their face.
ideas.title: Faces over the grill

ideas.text: Look for someone in full costume waiting patiently in a food line.
ideas.title: Costume in the queue

ideas.text: Use a slow shutter from a fixed spot so the crowd streams past a lit stall sign.
ideas.title: Crowd between stalls

queens-night-market-halloween.map: New York Hall of Science, 47-01 111th St, Queens, NY
queens-night-market-halloween.name: Queens Night Market Halloween finale
queens-night-market-halloween.note: The last night of the season, with trick-or-treating and costume contests.
queens-night-market-halloween.spot: Arrive before sunset to work the stalls in daylight, then stay for the hour after dark when the grills and lamps light faces.
queens-night-market-halloween.where: Flushing Meadows Corona Park, next to the New York Hall of Science
queens-night-market-halloween.why: Dozens of food stalls from around the world, smoke and string lights draw large crowds, and on the final night many come in costume.

santacon.time: 9 am to 9 pm; meeting point to be announced
